title: OmnisRouter Routing Receipt / ModelDecision (v1)
description: The routing decision for one request. Returned as the body of POST /v1/route, surfaced in compact form via response headers on routed calls, and persisted (content-free) as a decision-log row. Stable, versioned public contract.

policy_version.description: Version id of the routing model (centroids + policy table) that produced this decision; resolves to a downloadable, reproducible build (FR-006).

confidence.description: Top-1 temperature-scaled softmax probability over negative cosine distances.

top1_cosine_sim.description: Raw cosine similarity to nearest centroid (debug/audit field).

top2_cosine_sim.description: Raw cosine similarity to second-nearest centroid (debug/audit field).

alternatives.description: Ranked candidates considered for this cluster, each with predicted quality and estimated cost delta vs the chosen model.

est_cost_delta_usd.description: Signed delta vs the chosen model's estimated cost.

est_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost of the chosen model for this request, from the pinned pricing snapshot.

est_cost_delta_vs_big_usd.description: Estimated savings (negative = cheaper) vs the strongest candidate.

pricing_snapshot_date.description: Date of the pinned pricing snapshot used for cost math (Principle XII).
